incident-bot: PAGING: high 5xx-rate detected on prod-gateway (alert: gateway.5xx_rate > 1.5% over 5m)
incident-bot: Alert details -> query=`sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[5m])) * 100` = 2.3% :rotating_light:
Alice (oncall): I'm on it. Currently seeing a bunch of 504 / upstream_timeout to provider-alpha.
Ben (sre): confirming, traced to provider-alpha outbound pool. p95 latency for /v1/generate spiked from ~1.2s -> ~5.8s starting ~1718200800. 5xxs line up with their partial outage.
Alice (oncall): quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n gateway -l app=gateway -o wide` looks fine, CPU steady. Not seeing local OOMs.
Ben (sre): logs show upstream connection resets and `502` from proxy. Snippet:```[2026-05-12T14:40:12Z] upstream provider-alpha error: dial tcp 10.4.23.9:443: i/o timeout; req_id=abc123```
Mira (eng-infra): FYI provider-alpha is showing degraded in their status page https://status.provider-alpha.com/incidents/29 (they're confirming packet loss in eu-west).
Alice (oncall): Impact: customer-facing gen requests in eu-west and our routed dedicated pools hit elevated error-rate. Support is getting tickets. Leo can you collect a sample of customer request IDs?
Leo (support): Got a handful, forwarding 3 example IDs to this thread. Customers reporting "generation failed, try again later"; priority: 2.
Ben (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route new traffic away from provider-alpha to provider-beta for affected models; 2) enable degraded-mode caching for repeated prompts; 3) throttle long-running requests to preserve capacity.
Alice (oncall): Executing route change now. Command:```redwoodctl routing set --target provider-beta --selector region=eu-west --traffic 100% --dry-run=false``` -> applied. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Deploybot: routing change applied by Alice at 1718201402.
Ben (sre): Also bumped gateway replicas in eu-west: `redwoodctl scale pools/gateway-eu-west --replicas 6` to soak the short-term burst.
Mira (eng-infra): I pushed a temporary cache-policy to the CDN layer to honor 30s caching for idempotent endpoints. Should reduce repeated hits to providers.
Alice (oncall): After the reroute, 5xx-rate dropped to 0.7% within 3 minutes. p95 latency fell from 5.8s -> 1.4s. Good. :tada:
Sam (product): Thanks team — can we capture the root cause and follow up on alert sensitivity? This pinged SRE late at night.
Ben (sre): Agreed. Immediate next steps I propose: *lower noise* by changing the alert to require a sustained 5m AND affect >2 gateway instances, and *add a secondary metric* for upstream-timeout spikes so provider outages are more obvious.
Alice (oncall): Draft of new alert rule (PromQL):```avg_over_time((sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[1m]))) [5m:1m]) > 0.017 and count(up{job="gateway"} == 1) > 2``` Thoughts?
Ben (sre): Slight tweak: use `count_over_time` to ensure it's across multiple instances:```count_over_time((sum by (instance)(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) > 0.005)[5m:1m]) >= 2``` That prevents single-host flaps from paging.
Mira (eng-infra): Add a secondary alert: `upstream_timeout_rate{provider=~"provider-.*"}` > 0.01 for 3m to detect provider degradations before overall 5xx crosses threshold. Also suggest a dashboard panel: upstream latency heatmap by provider + region.
Sam (product): Also let's add an SLA-impact metric so paging includes estimated affected requests/min and which customers might see issues. Helps support triage.
Alice (oncall): I'll create a short post-incident runbook entry and a dashboard card. Quick TODOs: 1) update alert query and create fallback provider alert (Ben) 2) dashboard + SLA widget (Mira) 3) runbook note and handoff summary (Alice) 4) customer outreach template (Leo).
Ben (sre): I'll open the alert PR and tag @oncall and @eng-sre. Plan: change threshold to 1.7% sustained with instance-count guard and add provider-specific upstream_timeout alert.
Leo (support): I'll draft the customer message and flag affected accounts in the CRM for possible credits.
Alice (oncall): Handoff: Mira, you're on for remaining work after 1718204000 — I'll summarise what we did in ops-runbook and link the dashboard.
Mira (eng-infra): Got it. I'll own dashboard + monitor tests. Also will schedule a 30m follow-up postmortem doc with Ben and Alice.
Sam (product): Can we add a postmortem checklist item to evaluate multi-provider failover latency vs. cost? This outage shows we need better failover policy tuning.
Ben (sre): Agreed. Also we should add an automated test in staging that simulates provider-alpha failure and verifies routing fallback and cache behavior.
Alice (oncall): Closing the active page: 5xxs back to baseline, customer error reports stabilizing. I'll mark incident as Mitigated in the tracker and leave notes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident Mitigated at 1718203160 by Alice. Incident ID INC-20260512-021
Mira (eng-infra): Filing postmortem doc and checklist now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20260512-021 — assigning to Ben/Alice for analysis.
Ben (sre): After-action note: update alerts and add integration test + dashboard. I'll follow up with PR this afternoon.
Alice (oncall): Thanks all. If anything regresses ping this thread or page oncall. :pray:
